notes.title: Dec 10, 2021 - New Friday Build and Multiplayer Playtest
notes.content:
A new build is up! This build adds:
* status effects
* world map improvements
* the first of the final boss for Early Access
* a lot of localization updates
* title screen easter eggs
* and many other improvements!

Multiplayer testing is happening now at the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/triplejumpgames]official Twitch channel[/url]!!!

To sign up for this and future betas, join the [url=https://discord.gg/n4m5hw7]community Discord[/url] and message me (Triplejump)!
